name: Vatan.
source:
After her mother's death, Alya loses touch with herself. The only lead she can use is to return to the Motherland, to Crimea.

[Translated from [url=https://michaee.itch.io/vatan]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
母亲去世后，艾莉亚失去了自我。她唯一能利用的线索就是回到祖国，回到克里米亚。

[译自[url=https://michaee.itch.io/vatan]Itch.io[/url]]
